title: 世邦魏理仕 Zino Helmlinger：租金拐点何时来？核心资产已现回暖信号
speaker: Helm Linger

segments.en: So, how close do you think are we from the bottom of rental prices now Because your net absorption rate, as you said, I think quarter on quarter is down 17 percent And you said there's more supply coming through
segments.zh: 那么，您认为我们现在离租金底部有多近？因为正如您所说，净吸纳率环比下降了17%，而且您提到还有更多供应入市。

segments.en: So how close are we to this inflection point when landlords can start raising prices again So look, it's going to be a little bit of a balance
segments.zh: 那么，我们离这个拐点有多近，即业主可以再次提价的时候？所以，看，这将是一个小小的平衡。

segments.en: Obviously, if you look at most of the major cities suburbs and decentralized locations are going to see some rent decrease
segments.zh: 显然，如果你看大多数主要城市的郊区和分散地段，将会看到一些租金下降。

segments.en: And actually it's ongoing While prime real estate is seeing some increase So overall, we only see a bit of a rent decrease of about 1.3 percent here to date
segments.zh: 而且实际上这正在发生，而核心物业则看到一些增长。所以总体而言，我们迄今只看到约1.3%的租金小幅下降。

segments.en: So it's not huge But it's definitely a decrease and a lot of tenants and brands are seeing that as an opportunity
segments.zh: 所以降幅并不大，但确实是在下降，许多租户和品牌将此视为一个机会。

segments.en: Especially, you know, for prime real estate Because there is leasing demands toward those assets Brands are coming in and they want to make a statement
segments.zh: 尤其是对于核心物业，因为对这些资产有租赁需求。品牌正在进入，他们想要表明态度。

segments.en: So, I'm not too worried about the overall real estate situations right now I think it's going to hold and it's going to accelerate very soon
segments.zh: 所以，我现在不太担心整体房地产状况。我认为它会保持稳定，并且很快就会加速。
